notes.title: Fenimore Fillmore: 3 Skulls of the toltecs, Version 1.6.0, fix the aspect ratio issues.
notes.notes:
We released the version 1.6.0 that fix all the aspect ratio issues, but there is a new option called "Game Aspect" and you can choise 4:3 or 16:10, the reason for that is that, when we release the game in 1996 the real resolution of the game was 640x400 that is 16:10, but almost none of the screen of this age can manage the proper aspect ratio in fullscreen, so the game was outstretched to fix in fullscreen but the real aspect ratio was 16:10.

So if you want to play as the original outstretched select the option 4:3, but if you want to play as we designed it, select the option 16:10.

Finally there is a option called "Screen Aspect" and this should be in auto and the game calculate the proper aspect ratio using the resolution, but if you want to select it manualy, select the aspect ratio of your screen.

Thanks for you suport, enjoy!:lunar2019coolpig:

notes.title: Changed the audio system, we are not using mp3 anymore.
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we are not using mp3 sound system anymore , and we are using ogg right now.
So if you have a issue with crashing the game this version should fix it.

notes.title: Thanks to support Fenimore Fillmore games.

notes.title: Fixed most of the start bugs we had!
notes.notes:
Hello Fenimore Fillmore players,
We are very sorry to hear about the start bugs we had, really wasn't a good launch.
We are a really small indie team that to try to bring to live the Fenimore Fillmore series. We were worked as fast as possible to fix all the start bugs, so here you have the bugs already fixed.

1.- Sound issue, related to XAudio2_8.dll, Windows 7 and Windows 8 (fixed)
2.- Save games didn't work on certain windows configuration (fixed)
3.- Missing intro subtitles in Czech, Hungarian & Poland (fixed)

Also we added the skip option to the cut scenes and dialogs you asked for.

We hope you can enjoy it!

Thanks to support Fenimore Fillmore games.
